findings.evidence: Mathlib has `convex_halfSpace_lt` (Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/Basic.lean:297) but no unboundedness counterpart: grep for `halfSpace` / `unbounded_univ` in ./mathlib turns up nothing beyond `NormedSpace.unbounded_univ` (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Basic.lean:207). Nonemptiness of `K` enters only via `hφne`.
findings.fix: Extract `theorem not_isBounded_halfSpace_lt (φ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hφ : φ ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) : ¬ IsBounded {y | φ y < u}` (or the ray version) and reduce the main proof to: separate, note the half-space is preconnected and ⊆ Kᶜ, contradict `hx.subset hsub`.
findings.issue: Lines 99-133 are a self-contained general fact — a nonzero continuous ℝ-functional makes the open half-space `{y | φ y < u}` unbounded — inlined into `filledHull_subset_closedConvexHull`, where it accounts for two thirds of the proof and hides the reusable statement.

findings.evidence: Both sites are `rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]; exact (isBounded_convexHull.mpr hKb).closure`; line 174 is `rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull, diam_closure, convexHull_diam]`.
findings.fix: Add `isBounded_closedConvexHull : IsBounded (closedConvexHull ℝ K) ↔ IsBounded K` and `diam_closedConvexHull : diam (closedConvexHull ℝ K) = diam K` (neither is in the pinned Mathlib — only the `convexHull` forms at Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Convex.lean:159,164), then `isBounded_filledHull` and `diam_filledHull` reduce to one line each.
findings.issue: The derivation `IsBounded K → IsBounded (closedConvexHull ℝ K)` is written out twice verbatim (155-156 and 168-169), and the matching diameter step is inlined at 174.

findings.evidence: `DFunLike.ne_iff {f g : F} : f ≠ g ↔ ∃ a, f a ≠ g a` at Mathlib/Data/FunLike/Basic.lean:202.
findings.fix: Use `obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.mp hφne` (then `simpa using hw`), and prove `hφv` by `simp [v, hw]`/`field_simp` instead of the rewrite chain.
findings.issue: Lines 105-107 hand-roll `∃ w, φ w ≠ 0` via `by_contra`/`not_exists`/`not_not`/`ext`, duplicating existing API; lines 108-110 then `set v := … with hv` and immediately `rw [hv]`, which defeats the abbreviation and leaves a five-lemma rewrite chain (`map_smul, smul_eq_mul, neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀`).

summary: The topological file's proofs are clean, but the normed file buries a reusable general fact (open half-spaces are unbounded) inside a 47-line proof and duplicates the closed-convex-hull boundedness step twice; a couple of steps also hand-roll existing Mathlib API.
